description: PREREQUISITE migration: relocate the SRC-T BSE Tracker backend shell into MONO/backend without disturbing the three contract files, and make the four packages import under the editable install. Mechanical app.->backend.app. rename only (rule 5: relocate, do not rewrite). Design §3. Independent of FEAT-002..005 only in that it comes FIRST — everything else depends on it.
steps: Read docs/designs/step-2-data-unification.md §3 (all of §3.1-§3.5) and context.json FIRST.

Copy the SRC-T tree c:\GIT\Fintech\Tracker-Tool\backend\app\{models,repositories,routers,services,tasks,utils} plus app\cache.py, celery_app.py, config.py, database.py, dependencies.py, main.py into c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\backend\app\, and copy backend\alembic\ (incl. versions\ + env.py + script.py.mako + README), backend\alembic.ini, backend\seed_data.py, backend\Dockerfile, backend\requirements.txt into c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\backend\. Preserve every __init__.py so setuptools discovery finds the subpackages. DO NOT copy SRC-T backend\tests\ (the MONO suite lives in tests/).

DO NOT overwrite the existing contract files backend/app/schemas/{recommendation,snapshot,fusion}.py. Copy SRC-T's five schema modules (alert_schemas, portfolio_schemas, report_schemas, stock_schemas, user_schemas) into backend/app/schemas/ (no filename collision with the contract files).

MERGE backend/app/schemas/__init__.py per §3.3: copy SRC-T schemas/__init__.py VERBATIM (its imports from alert_schemas + report_schemas and its 29-name __all__) and PREPEND a contract block importing from backend.app.schemas.recommendation (Action, Recommendation), .snapshot (SNAPSHOT_TAIL_N, compute_snapshot_id), .fusion (fuse), with those 5 names prepended to __all__ (merged length 34). Rewrite the Tracker import lines app.schemas.* -> backend.app.schemas.*.

Rewrite EVERY intra-package import `app.` -> `backend.app.` across all relocated modules under backend/app/ (routers, services, repositories, tasks, utils, models, cache.py, celery_app.py, config.py, database.py, dependencies.py, main.py) AND in backend/alembic/env.py (all three: `from app.config`, `from app.database`, `import app.models`). This is a mechanical rename; do not change any logic.

Rewrite backend/alembic.ini: set `script_location = backend/alembic` (resolves from the repo-root invocation CWD) and KEEP `prepend_sys_path = .` (puts the repo root on sys.path so backend.app.* resolves). Leave file_template/timezone/logging as-is.
acceptance_criteria: backend/app/schemas/__init__.py exposes BOTH the contract symbols and the Tracker schemas: `from backend.app.schemas import Recommendation, AlertCreate, compute_snapshot_id` works and `len(backend.app.schemas.__all__) == 34`.
No `from app.` or `import app.` (top-level Tracker-style) import remains anywhere under backend/ including alembic/env.py — all are `backend.app.`.
The three contract files backend/app/schemas/{recommendation,snapshot,fusion}.py are byte-unchanged from before the feature.
verification: Grep-gate (not the final proof, just a guard): `grep -rn "^from app\.\|^import app\.\|^    from app\.\|^    import app\." c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\backend` returns nothing.

Import check after FEAT-002's dependency install (this feature cannot fully import until deps are merged in FEAT-002): at minimum `c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import backend.app.schemas as s; assert len(s.__all__)==34; from backend.app.schemas import Recommendation, AlertCreate, compute_snapshot_id; print('ok')"` — if deps are not yet installed, note the ModuleNotFoundError is expected and resolved by FEAT-002, but the schemas/__init__ merge itself must import cleanly.
`c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` still reports the pre-existing offline tests green (the relocation must not break the 39).
findings:
RELOCATION COMPLETE. The full SRC-T backend shell is now at c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\backend\, mechanical app.->backend.app. rename only (verified byte-identical to SRC-T-with-substitution across all 57 relocated files). SRC-T (c:\GIT\Fintech\Tracker-Tool) left untouched (read-only source).

- schemas/__init__.py MERGED: 5 contract names prepended (Action, Recommendation, SNAPSHOT_TAIL_N, compute_snapshot_id, fuse) to SRC-T's 29-name __all__ => len(__all__)==34. VERIFICATION RESULTS (all pass): (1) grep-gate for ^from app./^import app. (and 4-space-indented) returns NOTHING; (2) `.venv python -c import backend.app.schemas; len==34; from backend.app.schemas import Recommendation, AlertCreate, compute_snapshot_id` -> 'ok' (deps for schemas path already present in venv); (3) offline `.venv python -m pytest -q` = 39 passed (unchanged).
